description: Install one or more custom nodes via ComfyUI-Manager cm-cli (e.g. ComfyUI-Blip, WAS-Node-Suite). Requires COMFYUI_PATH and ComfyUI-Manager installed in custom_nodes. ComfyUI-Manager cm-cli requires Python package "rich" (pip install rich in your ComfyUI Python environment). Restart ComfyUI after install to load new nodes.

node_names.description: Node pack names as in ComfyUI-Manager (e.g. ComfyUI-Blip, ComfyUI-Impact-Pack)

name: install_custom_node
